reviews.comment: Professor Jeon is a good professor who knows what she is talking about. She wants you to do well, but you have to put in the work. There aren't many grades, so come to class and participate. Overall a pretty easy class if you study occasionally. Would definitely recommend taking if you need a B and don't want to put an insane amount of work in.

I really enjoyed Professor J. She lectures a lot, and during the summer course you have to be in class every day so you don't miss an entire section. She was super down to earth and kind- overall a very helpful and supportive person. Also if you go to office hours she will take the time to explain anything you ask in detail. Love her!!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A young and great professor! She fosters a thoughtful and encouraging class discussion environment. The content in this class was very interesting and she taught with passion. Lectures are exciting, fast-paced, and fun!
